cohort: 164 low-risk singleton pregnancies between 38-40 weeks of gestation
finding: Transvaginal cervical length at term positively correlates with time of onset of labor but not with duration of labor.
mod_finding: In patients with spontaneous onset of labor and cervical length <=30 mm, 70.3% had labor onset within 120 hours (5 days), compared to 22.58% with cervical length >30 mm; vaginal delivery occurred in 73.43% of those with cervical length <=30 mm. In induced labor, 61.9% with cervical length <=30 mm had labor onset within 120 hours compared to 30.6% with cervical length >30 mm; vaginal delivery occurred in 29.41% with cervical length <=30 mm compared to 65.30% with cervical length >30mm.
